I've saved the 261-seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal and confirmed it to Ilse in a thread reply in #north-team.

- **Earlier count:** The last count on record was 185 seats. Dana posted that in #north-team in August 2025 for Amendment No. 1, so the 261 figure replaces it. My reply mentions the change so the team doesn't mix up the two.
- **Sharing:** A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to discuss in the team channel. No approval was needed.
- **Duplicates:** The memory tool only catches exact duplicates right now, so a reworded version of the same fact could be saved twice.
